data.name: Biransh
data.gender_notes: Biransh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Biransh is a Sanskrit name that means 'God's shield'. It is derived from the words 'Bira' meaning God and 'Ansh' meaning essence or presence. This name is believed to bestow strength and protection on the bearer. The name Biransh carries the meaning “God's shield” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biransh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's shield and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biransh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
